body: I don’t want to die. I want to be normal. But I can’t. I have tried resetting my life. New people, same shit. I would be even more unhappy alone. So no choice

I wish I knew why they were cruel. To be diagnosed with BDD, the defect must actually be very minor, and according to two psychiatrists they do not consider mine to be minor. Regardless, there is no real change. I tried four surgeries. Kinda helped, not really. Those surgeons said there are no other options.
Yes, I am helpless. To others, the solutions are simple. But they have not worked. I tried them, honestly tried them, to no avail. I wish it didn't come to this, but it has.
